hook.name: SlotMachineHook
hook.description: A hook that collects a configurable fee (default 2%) on all ETH/token swaps and splits it into dual per-pool jackpots (main and side). ETH buy swaps meeting a minimum threshold trigger a randomized slot machine game, awarding ETH payouts from the jackpots for matching symbol combinations; sell-side fees are converted to ETH via a nested swap executor.
